findings.message: reads a likely secret source and opens a network connection in the same source file
findings.remediation: Keep secrets out of agent-visible output and require an allowlisted destination before egress.
findings.impact: A nearby secret source and network sink create a plausible credential-exposure path requiring data-flow review.
findings.attack_vector: Production code reads a non-environment secret source and opens a network connection within a bounded call-site window.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes commands to a shell-enabled process API
findings.remediation: Avoid shell execution; use fixed argv with execFile/spawn and reject untrusted input.
findings.impact: Shell-enabled process APIs can interpret metacharacters and execute attacker-controlled commands.
findings.attack_vector: A command reaches exec/spawn/execa with shell:true or a command-template helper.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: writes to system directories or boot locations
findings.remediation: Restrict file writes to user-owned directories with explicit approval.
findings.impact: System startup and installation directories are sensitive destinations for persistent modification.
findings.attack_vector: Source references a boot or system directory; this low lead does not by itself prove mutation or privilege.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: invokes an operating-system process API (2 calls in this file)
findings.remediation: Require explicit user approval and use a fixed allowlisted command with bounded arguments.
findings.downgrade: Downgraded from high: no system-impact pattern matched near the call site.
findings.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary OS commands on the host, leading to full system compromise.
findings.attack_vector: Plugin spawns a child process with attacker-controlled arguments; no user approval gate.
findings.risk_adjustment: Explicit risk (medium) set by caller; evidence-based risk adjustment skipped.

findings.message: contains 1 line(s) longer than 500 characters (possible minified/obfuscated code)
findings.remediation: Review extremely long lines; they may contain hidden logic.
findings.impact: Extremely long lines hide obfuscated or minified code from human review.
findings.attack_vector: Lines > 500 chars — code is structured to evade visual inspection.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
